notes.title: Xeno Rangers launch couch co-op playthrough
notes.content:
[p]Xeno Rangers is released today![/p][p][/p][p]Xeno Rangers is a Couch-Co Op Platformer Defense game where you must defend your HQ from enemy hordes by building your base and defenses wisely, while you fight using weapons & items acquired and upgraded along the way. It’s built for fans of Tower Defense and action platforming.[/p][p]
Game Features[/p][list][*][p]20+ action packed levels[/p][/*][*][p]Randomized replayable gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]15+ turrets with levels[/p][/*][*][p]45+ weapons[/p][/*][*][p]20+ items[/p][/*][*][p]30+ enemy types and bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple game modes[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Languages supported include English, German, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese and French.[/p][/*][/list]
